title: Visions of Judgment

questions.question: In the first vision, what was the Lord God forming?
questions.explanation: Amos 7:1 (ESV): "Behold, he was forming locusts when the latter growth was just beginning to sprout"

questions.question: In the second vision, the Lord God was calling for a judgment by what?
questions.explanation: Amos 7:4 (ESV): "Behold, the Lord God was calling for a judgment by fire,"

questions.question: In the third vision, the Lord was standing beside a wall built with what in his hand?
questions.explanation: Amos 7:7 (ESV): "and the Lord was standing beside a wall built with a plumb line, with a plumb line in his hand."

questions.question: "O Lord God, please forgive! How can Jacob stand? He is so..."?
questions.explanation: Amos 7:2 (ESV): "O Lord God, please forgive! How can Jacob stand? He is so small!"

questions.question: Amaziah said to Amos, "O seer, go, flee away to the land of..."?
questions.explanation: Amos 7:12 (ESV): "O seer, go, flee away to the land of Judah, and eat bread there, and prophesy there,"

questions.question: Who was Amaziah?
questions.explanation: Amos 7:10 (ESV): "Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel,"

questions.question: The Lord said, "Behold, I am setting a plumb line in the midst of my people Israel; I will never again..."?
questions.explanation: Amos 7:8 (ESV): "I will never again pass by them;"

questions.question: The high places of Isaac shall be made desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste, and I will rise against the house of whom with the sword?
questions.explanation: Amos 7:9 (ESV): "and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword."

questions.question: Amos answered Amaziah, "I was no prophet, nor a..."?
questions.explanation: Amos 7:14 (ESV): "I was no prophet, nor a prophet's son,"

questions.question: What was Amos's profession before prophesying?
options: Herdsman and dresser of sycamore figs
questions.correctAnswer: Herdsman and dresser of sycamore figs
questions.explanation: Amos 7:14 (ESV): "but I was a herdsman and a dresser of sycamore figs."

questions.question: To which king of Israel did Amaziah send a message accusing Amos of conspiring against him?
questions.explanation: Amos 7:10 (ESV): "Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel,"

questions.question: Amaziah said, "The land is not able to bear all his..."?
questions.explanation: Amos 7:10 (ESV): "the land is not able to bear all his words."

questions.question: Amos prophesied to Amaziah: "Your wife shall be a prostitute in the city, and your sons and your daughters shall fall by the sword, and your land shall be divided up with..."?
questions.explanation: Amos 7:17 (ESV): "and your land shall be divided up with a measuring line;"

questions.question: Amaziah told Amos not to prophesy anymore at Bethel because it was whose sanctuary?
questions.explanation: Amos 7:13 (ESV): "for it is the king's sanctuary, and it is a temple of the kingdom."

questions.question: What happened after Amos prayed, "O Lord God, cease! How can Jacob stand?"
questions.explanation: Amos 7:6 (ESV): "The Lord relented concerning this: 'This also shall not be,' says the Lord God."

key_verse_text: And the Lord said to me, "Amos, what do you see?" And I said, "A plumb line." Then the Lord said, "Behold, I am setting a plumb line in the midst of my people Israel; I will never again pass by them;"
